svg.title: ARC-002 General Notes, Symbols & Compliance
svg.text: EZBIT ABU RUKBAH, QUESNA, MENOUFIA, EGYPT · ECP 201 — Egyptian Code for Loads · ECP 203 — Egyptian Code for Reinforced Concrete · Code 305 — Protection of Structures from Fire
1. Figured dimensions govern. Do not scale from these drawings.
2. Dimensions are in millimetres unless a metre value is shown
with two decimals. Levels are in metres to the project datum,
which is the ground floor finished floor level, +0.00.
3. Dimensions to structural faces unless noted. Opening sizes are
structural; frame and tolerance allowances are the supplier's.
4. Every discrepancy between drawings is to be referred before
any work is set out or any material ordered.
5. Boundaries, levels and the neighbours' heights are as
described by the client and await a measured survey, SUR-001.
6. Foundations, framing and every member size are the structural
engineer's and are not set on any architectural sheet. The STR
series is issued as layout for that design.
7. Services layouts are coordination only. Cable, duct and pipe
sizes, loads and capacities are the services engineer's.
8. Materials, finishes, waterproofing build-ups and performance
specifications are not set by these drawings.
External / party wall cut by section, 300 mm —
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. The matrix carries our figure for every item a house is
normally tested against, measured from the geometry and
2. The required value, the clause and the verdict are left
open on purpose. They belong to ECP 201, ECP 203 and Code
305, and to whoever signs the compliance statement; a
column of limits invented here would be worse than an
empty one, because it would be believed.
3. Code 305 governs fire. It is named here and nowhere
quoted: the edition in force is confirmed with Civil
Protection, and how it treats a detached single-family
dwelling is the question the exits row turns on.
4. The symbols panel is the same key every sheet in the set
carries, so a reader who has this sheet can read any of
